REMARK: AS TO THE JUL-11-24 EX PARTE APPLICATION OF AMERICAN ADVANCED MANAGEMENT INC. AND KENTFIELD & SAN FRANCISCO SPECIALTY HOSPITAL, INC. FOR LEAVE TO INTERVENE, THE COURT CONTINUES THE MATTER TO JUL-15-2024 AT 11:00 A.M. IN DEPARTMENT 302. JUDGE: RICHARD B. ULMER JR.; CLERK: V. DA FONSECA; NOT REPORTED. (302/RBU)

REMARK: AS TO THE JUL-15-24 EX PARTE APPLICATION OF AMERICAN ADVANCED MANAGEMENT INC. AND KENTFIELD & SAN FRANCISCO SPECIALTY HOSPITAL, INC. FOR LEAVE TO INTERVENE, THE COURT DENIES THE APPLICATION. THE APPLICATION DOES NOT MEET CCP 387'S REQUIREMENTS. THE "ASSURANCE OF VOLUNTARY COMPLIANCE RE NONPROFIT HOSPITAL TRANSACTION" ENTERED BY THE PARTIES TO THIS ACTION REFERS TO "LONG-TERM ACUTE CARE HOSPITAL SERVICES" BEING MAINTAINED FOR 10 YEARS, BUT THE ASSURANCE DOES NOT STATE THAT APPLICANTS ARE TO PROVIDE THOSE SERVICES. (ID. AT P. 10.) APPLICANTS SEEK TO IMPORT THEIR SEPARATE LITIGATION WITH ANOTHER NONPARTY INTO THIS ACTION, WHICH WOULD BE IMPROPER. JUDGE: RICHARD B. ULMER JR.; CLERK: V. DA FONSECA; NOT REPORTED. (302/RBU)
